items.title: Explore free skills courses with TESDA Online Program
items.summary: Browse TESDA's technical-vocational learning catalog, including ICT, entrepreneurship and digital literacy. Check the provider's current enrollment conditions before registering.
items.eligibility: Course-specific requirements may apply; verify on the official site.

items.title: Explore technology skills with Cisco Networking Academy
items.summary: Discover introductory learning opportunities in cybersecurity, networking and programming. Available courses and enrollment conditions are set by Cisco.
items.eligibility: Check individual course access, account and age requirements.

items.title: Build digital skills through Microsoft Learn Student Hub
items.summary: Explore self-paced learning materials and student-oriented technology resources. Check eligibility for any tools, credentials or additional benefits separately.
items.eligibility: Some programs and benefits have separate eligibility requirements.
